data.description:

Several records show a long history of hiring babysitters and dropping the child off at her neighbor's house to avoid providing care. She could not answer basic questions about how her child got to school everyday and when they had last eaten.

She does not consider her child to be her responsibility at all and frequently refers to the victim as 'deadweight', 'loser', or 'gremlin'. She's very immature and spoiled, unwilling to spending even a little quality time with her child. Considers it boring and lame.

We at the MRU are hopeful that, given time, she will be able to share her energy and passion with her child instead of considering them a deadweight.
